Research continuation completed across all eight selected chapters. The workspace was read-only, so `research-ledger-manifest.json` could not be updated; the following globally new provisional IDs should be appended during the next writable handoff.

New defensible units:

- `WEB-1B-13`: The DRC created the Conseil National de Cyberdéfense in August 2023 by presidential ordinance, establishing a specialized presidential cyber-defense service. This supports implementation of the cybersecurity strategy, but not effectiveness. Lenses: `1B.1`, `1B.7`, `1B.9`. [UNE.CD](https://www.une.cd/rdc-jean-claude-bukasa-nomme-coordonnateur-du-conseil-national-de-cyberdefense-par-ordonnance-presidentielle), [official legal text](https://are.gouv.cd/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/04042023-ORDONNANCE-LOI-23-010-DU-13-MARS-PORTANT-CODE-DU-NUMERIQUE_compressed.pdf).

- `WEB-1B-14`: The digital-code claim is recoverable through the DRC legal text hosted by Refworld and the official ordinance-law PDF, correcting the mismatched prior locator. The code provides legal infrastructure for cybercrime, cryptology, electronic evidence, and digital governance; implementation outcomes remain unverified. Lenses: `1B.1`, `1B.7`, `1B.9`.

- `WEB-1B-15`: UNJHRO/MONUSCO documented 5,273 human-rights violations and abuses nationally in 2023, including 4,473 in five conflict provinces; this represents a 12% national decrease from 2022 but continuing severe conflict-zone exposure. This is independent outcome context, not proof of presidential effectiveness. Lenses: `1B.8`, `1B.10`. [MONUSCO/UNJHRO](https://monusco.unmissions.org/fr/news/principales-tendances-des-violations-des-droits-de-lhomme-en-rdc-1er-janvier-au-31).

- `WEB-2B-12`: The signed MONUSCO disengagement note is available as UN document `S/2023/904`, confirming the 21 November 2023 agreement and its withdrawal-review framework. This replaces the prior search-summary locator. Lenses: `2B.1`, `2B.7`, `2B.10`. [UN document](https://documents.un.org/api/symbol/access?l=en&s=s%2F2023%2F904&t=pdf).

- `WEB-2B-13`: Resolution 2717 required gradual, responsible MONUSCO withdrawal with handover tied to civilian-protection considerations, while extending the mission through December 2024. The arrangement confirms a negotiated peacekeeping transition but not improved security. Lenses: `2B.7`, `2B.10`. [Resolution PDF](https://monusco.unmissions.org/sites/default/files/res_2717_2023_n2341267_en_0.pdf).

- `WEB-3B-07`: UNJHRO’s year-end data show a national decline in documented abuses but persistent concentration in conflict provinces. This provides a contrary/mixed line against an exclusively negative national trend, while confirming severe regional exposure. Lenses: `3B.1`, `3B.6`, `3B.7`, `3B.10`. [MONUSCO/UNJHRO](https://monusco.unmissions.org/fr/news/principales-tendances-des-violations-des-droits-de-lhomme-en-rdc-1er-janvier-au).

- `WEB-4B-08`: The original CENCO-ECC election declaration is available as a PDF and should replace secondary summaries for the observer findings. It records the mission’s direct assessment of the 20 December 2023 presidential, legislative, and provincial elections. Lenses: `4B.1`, `4B.2`, `4B.4`, `4B.5`, `4B.8`, `4B.10`. [CENCO-ECC declaration](https://cencordc.org/attachments/article/416/VF_D%C3%A9claration_MOE_CENCO-ECC_2023.pdf).

- `WEB-4B-09`: The Carter Center’s final report independently documents election-observation findings and notes the scale of CENCO-ECC domestic observation, providing a separate source family for electoral-integrity assessment. Lenses: `4B.1`, `4B.4`, `4B.5`, `4B.6`, `4B.8`, `4B.10`. [Carter Center final report](https://www.cartercenter.org/resources/pdfs/news/peace_publications/election_reports/drc/drc-final-report-2023.pdf).

- `WEB-5B-09`: The DRC Ministry of Budget maintains a 2023 budget document set, including execution instructions and credit-development tables. This is a primary recovery path for expenditure-quality and fiscal-execution claims, though the available search result does not yet establish outcome quality. Lenses: `5B.3`, `5B.6`, `5B.7`, `5B.8`. [Ministry of Budget](https://budget.gouv.cd/budget-2023/).

- `WEB-6B-09`: No nationally representative household survey was available for the target period; the later 2024 household survey is described as the first nationwide survey in more than a decade. This confirms that 2023 distributional welfare claims should remain evidence-limited rather than inferred from aggregate indicators. Lenses: `6B.1`, `6B.2`, `6B.3`, `6B.10`. [Joint Data Center](https://www.jointdatacenter.org/drc-household-living-conditions-survey/).

- `WEB-7B-06`: The recovered CENCO-ECC primary declaration improves the integrity evidence base but still does not establish Tshisekedi’s personal enrichment, concealment, or direct manipulation. Institutional irregularity remains distinct from personal culpability. Lenses: `7B.1`, `7B.2`, `7B.6`, `7B.7`, `7B.8`, `7B.10`.

- `WEB-8B-07`: A March 2023 government implementation meeting reported that PDL-145T agencies had begun preparing deliverables and created a public phone-based tracking mechanism for project execution. This supports machinery and monitoring activity, but not completed works or beneficiary outcomes. Lenses: `8B.2`, `8B.3`, `8B.5`, `8B.6`, `8B.7`. [Primature](https://www.primature.gouv.cd/2023/03/11/programme-de-developpement-local-des-145-territoires-les-premiers-ouvrages-vont-etre-livres-des-le-mois-davril-selon-les-rapports-de-differentes-agences-dexecution-remis-au-premier-ministre-sam/).

Overall, the continuation recovered primary election documents, a primary MONUSCO withdrawal document, cyber-institution implementation evidence, independent human-rights trend data, and a primary fiscal-document pathway. The remaining gaps are chiefly verified implementation outcomes, personal-integrity evidence, and representative population-level welfare data. No score or ranking was produced.
